block.goal: Extract the cohesive callback and request-resolution configuration from IndirectClient to reduce its public API and implementation responsibility while preserving the existing IndirectClient configuration methods through delegation.

ops.details: Extract the cohesive callback and request-resolution state and behavior: callbackUrl, urlResolver, callbackUrlResolver, ajaxRequestResolver, getCallbackUrl(), setCallbackUrl(String), getUrlResolver(), setUrlResolver(UrlResolver), getCallbackUrlResolver(), setCallbackUrlResolver(CallbackUrlResolver), getAjaxRequestResolver(), setAjaxRequestResolver(AjaxRequestResolver), and the corresponding default initialization currently performed in beforeInternalInit(boolean). Keep IndirectClient's existing public accessors as delegating methods so existing subclasses and callers remain source-compatible. Update getRedirectionAction(WebContext, SessionStore), computeFinalCallbackUrl(WebContext), beforeInternalInit(boolean), and toString() to use the extracted configuration object.
